name: mirage
text: Understood: wins are the goal. Honest picture: right now only 64 of 65,000 RFQs are priceable, so the maker rarely quotes and wins nothing. The fastest safe fix is same-game pairs (about 4x more than any other missed group), but quoting them with a guessed correlation would win quotes precisely when we're underpricing, so I'm building it from the SGP correlation logs and checking it in shadow before it quotes real money (your live limits stay as they are). Second, fair coverage for NFL/NCAAF game lines and a looser fair-age limit for game lines. I'll report the shadow numbers (how many more RFQs we price and how many we would win) here as soon as the new rule has run.
